clips.title: The story
paras: Wynne Larson works fine spider silk into a garment in Stormwind City. An adventurer brings her rare silk gathered from the wilds, and she tailors it into a magical weave for dangerous journeys and high-society gatherings.

In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, tailors serve arcane elites and visiting nobles. Wynne Larson is known for weaving pristine spider silk into durable, enchanted garments. Her playful humor comes through when she jokes about saving a few precious scraps for her own wardrobe before handing over her finished work.

Spellcasters who wear cloth prize the Astral Knot Garment for its resilience and refinement. Its silk comes from dangerous spiders, and its weave is made to endure combat while keeping the polished look expected at formal banquets in Stormwind Keep.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your garment is ready! And that silk you gathered was so nice... You don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some silk left over for me, do you?
I'm only joking. It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining. Enjoy!
